description: FOR x IN [a, b] DO ... END FOR iterates the ARRAY literal's elements, binding the loop variable to each element's VALUE (booleans as real BOOLEAN literals, not truthy strings - a FALSE flag must take the false branch of IFF), an empty array runs zero iterations, and IFF rejects non-BOOLEAN conditions at compile time (Invalid argument types) while NULL conditions choose the else branch. Converted 1:1 from features/ForOverArrayLiteralTest (now retired). The two binding tests skip the snowflake backend: binding the loop variable of a FOR-over-array-literal into the body's SQL is a Frostlake extension (a real account's FOR takes a range or cursor, so the body's binds are never set there).

skip.reason: FOR-over-array-literal binds are a Frostlake extension; live FOR takes a range or cursor

steps.sql: CREATE TABLE loop_out (val VARCHAR, branch VARCHAR)
SELECT val, branch FROM loop_out ORDER BY val
